description:
Update an existing invoice auto reminder configuration by its configuration ID.

This function performs a full update of the reminder configuration's timing interval, repetition count and notification preferences.

inputSchema.description: Full replacement configuration for an existing invoice auto reminder. All required fields must be included since this performs a full update.

interval.description: The interval at which to send the reminder. The interval unit is always DAY.

value.description: The number of interval units before/after the due date at which to send the reminder.

send_to_invoicer.description: Indicates whether to also notify the invoicer when the reminder is sent.

reminder_configuration_id.description: The ID of the auto reminder configuration to update.

repetition.description: The number of times to send the reminder. Must be 1 for BEFORE_DUE reminders.

name: update_invoice_auto_reminder
